name: Ootori Emu
source:
Emu is a rather naive girl with an endless source of cheerfulness. She always immediately acts on any idea that she comes up with, and often drags others around her into her schemes. She is actively looking for people who can help her revive the Phoenix Wonderlands Stage which has fallen on hard times.

She's part of the musical show unit Wonderlands×Showtime.

[From in-game profile]
